req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) return application/json content type. Tests cover: (1) positive EP for each method returning exact 'application/json' content-type, (2) negative path for wrong HTTP method returning 405 (not 2xx, not JSON), (3) boundary check that the content-type header starts with exactly 'application/json' and not a superset/subset string, (4) decision table covering all five endpoints systematically, (5) negative path verifying non-echo endpoints do not accidentally satisfy the same contract. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact content-type string prefix, and exact JSON structure keys.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Import app via from httpbin.core import app
Inspect status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> /get endpoint -> view_get() -> jsonify() -> Content-Type: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Inspect status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> /post endpoint -> view_post() -> jsonify() -> Content-Type: application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_returns_application_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/post', data=json.dumps({'key': 'value'}),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'
    assert body['json'] == {'key': 'value'}

test_post_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain
actions: Send correct method to each echo endpoint
Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (with optional charset)
Assert it does NOT equal 'text/html' or 'text/plain'
expected: Content-Type starts with 'application/json' for all five endpoints
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> boundary: content-type string must be application/json not any other type
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain():
    client = app.test_client()
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} got {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'{method} {path}: got {ct}'
        assert not ct.startswith('text/html'), f'{method} {path}: got text/html'
        assert not ct.startswith('text/plain'), f'{method} {path}: got text/plain'
        assert 'application' in ct
        assert 'json' in ct

test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_decision_table_status_and_content_type
preconditions: All five echo endpoints accessible with correct HTTP methods
actions: Build decision table of (method, path, expected_status, expected_ct_prefix)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> DT covering all five endpoints with correct methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_all_echo_endpoints_decision_table_status_and_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    table = [
        ('GET',    '/get',    200, 'application/json'),
        ('POST',   '/post',   200, 'application/json'),
        ('PUT',    '/put',    200, 'application/json'),
        ('PATCH',  '/patch',  200, 'application/json'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete', 200, 'application/json'),
    ]
    for method, path, exp_status, exp_ct in table:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == exp_status, f'{method} {path}: status {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith(exp_ct), f'{method} {path}: Content-Type={ct}'
        body = json.loads(r.data)
        assert isinstance(body, dict), f'{method} {path}: body not dict'

test_all_echo_endpoints_decision_table_status_and_content_type()

def test_put_with_json_body_returns_json_content_type_and_reflects_json():
